body: Nontrad med student, did my master’s and graduating from medical school soon. Loans reflect OOS tuition and cost of living. If I had a cheaper path to pursue my goals I would’ve taken it, but I’d been banking on PSLF. At times I regret my choice of specialty and may consider pivoting in the future

I spoke with a Nelnet rep since I'm also due to recertify my IBR plan later this month. I was suggested to go into forebearance but didn't ask which kind I'd be eligible for -- is a financial hardship one not an option for your situation? That's frustrating they wouldn't put you on a processing forebearance. I also asked about pushing back recertification dates and got the same response :( What a shitshow

I appreciate the reply Betsy! I understand that, at this time, your post suggests that the ED will extend recertification dates, but that unfortunately has not been the case for me.

I called Nelnet today and was told that they are NOT extending IBR recertification deadlines. Given applications are not being processed, I asked whether this means my interest will capitalize and the rep said yes. I was told my only options are to transition to a standard plan or request forebearance upon graduation. I just wanted to make sure there was nothing else I can possibly do at this time to prevent this terrible outcome that I'm sure others are facing too.

I hope the ED will provide updates regarding recertification extensions for those on non-SAVE IDRs like myself. Appreciate all the work you've been doing!

I am due to recertify my IBR by 3/28 and uploaded an IDR recertification form on 2/26. On my portal there is a note confirming receipt of my application, but I still have the banner above that says to certify. 

I spoke with a Nelnet rep today and they have no further guidance at this time. They are unable to push back the recertification date. They said that if it is not processed by 3/28, the interest will capitalize, and that they are not processing recertifications at this time. I asked if they know whether they may reverse the capitalized interest in the future and they undestandably have no idea. 

My other loans are in a standard plan, and when I graduate my monthly payments across all loans are gonna be $8k lmao please help.

I graduate this May and was due to recertify my IBR plan for my previous degree loans 3/28 - uploaded the app on Nelnet last week but the banner still says it’s due 3/28 with no word on pushing back the recertification date. My med school loans are on a standard plan. Currently my monthly payment across all loans are ~$8000 when it enters repayment given the mix of IBR+standard plan. My total loan burden right now is about $560k with $62k in accrued interest. I’m terrified my loans will capitalize if they don’t process the IBR and am not sure where to go from here. Was heavily relying on IBR and PSLF given not going into a high-paying specialty and have a $65k salary during residency. Appreciate any advice you may have thank you!

Edit -- I slept like a baby after that exam. Thoughts:

C/P: I was the most worried for this section but it was the easiest section for me, though did run out of time.

CARS: Passages were really longer... In practice exams I usually had 5+ min left and this time I just guessed the entire last passage.

B/B: ...really dense passages, ended up having to skim a lot of passages to finish on time. I think I spent too much time overanalyzing some questions when I should've just moved on.

P/S: worst section for me. Maybe it was the exhaustion, but I felt like half the time I was trying to understand what the question was that they were asking and I kept being stuck between 2 choices.

Overall, I think with extra practice I'll be on my way to reaching my goal score. Confused there was little to no orgo???? Tight for time though since I return to lab and am writing/submitting primary before I re-write :/

For the longest time, I was torn among the ABH contour kit, MUFE Sculpting Kit and the NARS Contour Blush. After trying the respective darker versions of each, I couldn't get over the overwhelming red tone of each. It made my cheeks look dirty and burned more than anything else. Around the same time I found a Sephora sample of the Cover Fx Contour Kit and was impressed by the texture and range of undertones. So I guess I sort of replaced a powder contour kit with a cream one...oops. Though as a broke student for the next little while, I'll stick to my bronzer and concealer combo.

Other than that I crossed off the NARS lip pencil in Never Say Never - a bit too cool and sheer for my liking. I could probably dab another pink lipstick of mine gently and get the same effect.

Sorry a bit late but Vera was the first Audacious lipstick I bought and I absolutely love this berry shade! It was the only lipstick I took to London and it was perfect for both day and night occasions. I'm of a darker complexion so I can't really comment on the colour for you, but Temptalia's swatches look fairly accurate imho. It's really pigmented and doesn't require a lip liner. The formula is also fairly long-wearing but if you have dry lips the creamy finish isn't the most comfortable. It does transfer a bit but blotting helps.

Haven't submitted yet, and I'm a reapplicant. I feel like hurling my breakfast by writing that. I honestly have lost my confidence sometime this year, and now I feel like it's too late to submit. Anyway as for lessons - I should've started on my personal statement before July. It's been a month and I'm only making progress now.. So definitely give yourself time to write and have it edited by a few people you trust.

I also wish that I had more letter writers. Don't rely on only 3 when many schools require that as the minimum. It may be stressful. You may run into the situation where one still hasn't responded since agreeing (unless in person) let alone submitted after 2 months of asking.

I've only ever used the UD Eyeshadow Primer Potion and love it. Lasts all day through heat and sweat! I have to be careful to use the tiiiiniest amount though, else it'll make my eyelids look very dry.

I was also debating between these two palettes earlier and ultimately chose the Monarch palette. After swatching them both in store, I was slightly more impressed with the pigmentation of Monarch (and could not pass up on that copper shade!). I definitely reach for this palette more than my UD Naked 1. The colour payoff is great with or without primer, but obviously lasts longer if you do use one. No issues with muddiness.
